title: Workspace declaration (workspace.yaml), #50
description: Machine contract for workspace.yaml, validated by `scripts/ws validate` (via scripts/check-workspace, zero-dependency hand-walk — no pyyaml/jsonschema). `required` lists the top-level keys a compliant workspace.yaml must declare; `x_required_paths` (a non-standard extension consumed by check-workspace) lists the skeleton files/dirs a compliant workspace must contain — the usage surface plus `platform-internals/`, the self-proving layer that makes a green `ws health` mean something. `suites/` left this list in #93: the SUITE contract and the stub moved into `platform-internals/suites/`, and a top-level `suites/` comes back as a mount point when the first real suite ships (#43). The manifest field slot is co-owned by #41/#50; #50 fills the machine-validation half. `team-context/manifest.yaml` is required so a workspace missing the Context Manifest fails `validate` with a clear message instead of failing `health` obscurely.

repositories.description: frozen placeholder — always [], required so the key stays present; the real per-developer mount list ({id, path}) lives in workspace.local.yaml (gitignored)

repo_catalog.description: the team's real repos tagged by role, {org, repos:[{id,roles}]}. Required — scripts/setup-repos hard-depends on it and aborts with `FAIL: no repo_catalog found` if absent.

agent_suites.description: mounted vertical suites, {id, source, version, entry}

required_local_permissions.description: {mechanism, check, guide} entries (or legacy plain strings)

skill_catalog.description: curated always-mounted skills selected from inside a skills-source monorepo, {source, skills:[{id,category,roles}]}. Optional — the long tail stays discoverable on demand instead of pre-mounted.

upstream.description: the template this workspace was instantiated from: {url, branch, synced_commit}. Optional (absent in the template itself). synced_commit is the full sha of the upstream commit the framework-owned paths currently match — scripts/check-ownership compares against it, scripts/upstream-pin bumps it on every sync. Ownership classes: platform-internals/ownership.yaml.
